hypothesis: The exact-C reverse_any multiclass objective may spend capacity separating failure modes without enforcing a coherent success probability. A fixed conditional failure chain can learn the same mutually exclusive auxiliary labels with three binary tasks and obtain P(success) as a probability product.

relationship_to_prior_failure_decomposit.prior: V4 catboost_failure_decomp independently predicted overlapping component15 reverse/middle/wayoff indicators and clipped 1 minus their sum.
relationship_to_prior_failure_decomposit.structural_difference: This experiment uses mutually exclusive reverse_any classes, trains each later task only conditional on earlier failures not occurring, and multiplies conditional survival probabilities. No overlapping probabilities are subtracted.

data_contract.auxiliary_label_rule: next same-pitcher official as-of counter deltas inside completed history only

models: P(wide | not reverse and not middle)

source_gate.on_fail: Close H4 without reading 2022+ candidate labels.
source_gate.on_pass: Freeze chain and train 2022/2023 before any 2024 candidate run.
